echo_sets.name: Moonlit Clouds
echo_sets.note: Energy Regen and 22.5% ATK to the next character on Outro; the Heron refunds energy for his expensive Liberation.

echo_sets.name: Sierra Gale
echo_sets.note: The main-DPS-oriented option: Aero DMG with more after Intro. Use Nightmare: Feilian Beringal if you have Rinascita access.

echo_sets.name: Moonlit Clouds + Sierra Gale
echo_sets.note: Game8's second-best mix: Aero DMG plus Energy Recharge while farming full sets.

build.energy_regen_target: not published; top substat priority — his Liberation costs 150 energy
build.fast_path: Fast path: The Last Dance + 5-piece Moonlit Clouds in a 4-3-3-1-1 layout with Impermanence Heron in the main slot. Run a CRIT 4-cost, Aero DMG 3-costs (Energy Regen if needed), ATK% 1-costs, and stack Energy Regen first — Game8 rates it his top substat since his 150-energy Liberation is expensive.

ranked_weapons.name: The Last Dance
ranked_weapons.note: Not his signature — he is 4-star — but Game8's best pick: ATK plus Resonance Skill DMG on Intro and Liberation casts.

ranked_weapons.name: Static Mist
ranked_weapons.note: Energy Regen plus an ATK gift to the incoming Resonator when he Outros.

ranked_weapons.name: Undying Flame
ranked_weapons.note: Resonance Skill DMG on Intro; a simple damage stick.

ranked_weapons.name: Novaburst
ranked_weapons.note: ATK that stacks on dashes and dodges, suiting his hit-and-run playstyle.

ranked_weapons.name: Cadenza
ranked_weapons.note: 4-star Energy and Concerto option, also named among his best by community guides.

Aero DMG ideally; Energy Regen if his 150-energy Liberation lags behind the rotation.

profile.role_note: Aero DMG Deepen on Outro; his Mist Avatar taunts enemies. Game8 also documents a Main-DPS build.

pull_verdict.source_guide: research: community build sources (no site pull guide exists)
pull_verdict.verdict: Do not pull specifically for him, but he is a strong free-friendly Aero buffer for Jiyan teams if you already have him.
